cubeworld.customize.pregen.columns: About %s chunk columns before you join
cubeworld.customize.presets.title: Cube World Presets
cubeworld.customize.preset.every_climate: Desert, jungle, snow, savanna and taiga
cubeworld.customize.preset.desert_planet: A hot and dry climate. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubeworld.customize.preset.frozen_planet: A very cold climate with snowy plains, snowy taiga, ice spikes and frozen peaks. Sets Temperature
cubeworld.customize.preset.jungle_planet: A warm and wet climate with every jungle. Sets Temperature and Humidity
A very wet climate with swamp and mangrove swamp. Sets Humidity
cubeworld.customize.preset.badlands_plan: A very hot and dry climate with all three badlands. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubeworld.customize.preset.savanna_plane: A warm and dry climate with savanna, savanna plateau and windswept savanna. Sets Temperature and Humidity
cubeworld.customize.preset.mountains.des: Jagged peaks, stony peaks, snowy slopes, windswept hills and grove
cubeworld.customize.preset.ocean_world.d: Warm, lukewarm, cold, frozen and deep ocean
cubeworld.customize.preset.wonderland.de: Cherry grove, flower forest, sunflower plains and meadow
cubeworld.customize.preset.haunted_woods: Dark forest, pale garden and swamp
cubeworld.customize.preset.giant_trees.d: Old growth pine, spruce and birch, and bamboo jungle
cubeworld.customize.preset.temple_tour.d: Desert pyramid, jungle temple, igloo and swamp hut
cubeworld.customize.preset.treasure_hunt: Buried treasure, shipwreck, ocean ruins, trail ruins and ruined portal
cubeworld.customize.preset.caves.descrip: Lush caves, dripstone caves, deep dark and sulfur caves
cubeworld.customize.preset.structure_hun: Village, outpost, mansion, monument and ancient city
options.cubeworld.edgeCameraTilt.tooltip: When on, the camera turns with the ground over a rounded cube edge. Turn it off if the tilt makes you feel sick. When off, the camera stays level with the face and turns quickly when you cross onto the next face. Flight still tilts.
